rules.notes: safe_harbor=full per Bugcrowd dump (safe_harbor field='full'). Program is managed by Bugcrowd staff (managed_by_bugcrowd=true). Per-asset severity_cap not in Bugcrowd dump; defaulted to unknown for all entries — read the engagement's Rewards tab before drafting medium/low severity reports. Bounty table coarse-grained — only max_payout known from dump ($10,000 USD); manually refine from engagement page if drafting against medium/low severity. mass_scanning_allowed=false: safe default — not stated explicitly in dump; verify from full policy text on engagement page. automated_tools_allowed=false: safe default — not stated explicitly in dump; verify from full policy text on engagement page. cve_age_min_days=30: safe default — not stated in dump. requires_ownership_proof=true: safe default — not stated in dump. submission_form URL is best-guess; confirm by reading https://bugcrowd.com/engagements/seek once before pasting (Bugcrowd has reorganized engagement URLs in the past). Note: *.outfra.xyz, *.skinfra.xyz, *.myseek.xyz, *.aips-internal.com, and *.sol-data.com appear to be SEEK internal/infrastructure domains — confirm in-scope intent from engagement page before testing.
